title: HQ continuation (picked on 2021-11..2024-12) #2
question: Owner 2026-10-23: a strategy that trades 2+ times a week, high-quality setups, high probability and high profit - trend continuation with structure (first pullback after a directional session leg).

rules: Session: London (02:00-05:00 leg, entries until 07:30) and NY (09:30-11:30 leg, entries until 12:00), one position at a time.
Opening structure: the range before the session (Asia 20:00-00:00 for London, the overnight 18:00-09:30 for NY).
Directional leg: the session's first 5m close beyond it, leg >= 4 x the 5m ATR(14) from the session's low (high); only the first leg of the session counts.
Entry zone: the first pullback into the leg's most recent 5m fair value gap within 120 minutes of the leg; below the leg origin first = no trade.
Trigger (within 30 minutes of the touch): a 5m close beyond the prior candle's high (long) / low (short); entry at the next 5m open + 1 tick.
Stop: 1 tick beyond the leg origin (6-80 pts, else no trade).
Time exit: 15:55 ET. One trade a session.
Size: $800 risk up to a 20-pt stop, then 800 x 20 / stop (max 40 micros); $1.90 a micro, 1 tick slippage on market fills.

method: exact live-loop replay (20-day window per session) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included
